definition: farm animals kept for use or profit
description: On a narrow village street at sunrise, a young woman with a long red braid, in a waxed jacket, jeans and green wellington boots, walks towards the viewer swinging a metal bucket and leading a crowd of farm animals down the wet road: black and white cows, pink pigs, sheep, goats, white geese and brown hens, with breath steaming in the cold. Parked cars and a milk van stand behind them, and people watch from the doorways of grey stone houses, one of them waving.

taps.phrase: to wave in his dressing gown
